from pathlib import Path
import json,re
bases=[
 Path("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts"),
 Path.home()/".dc-platform/memory/mirrors/agent-transcripts",
]
day_marker="Friday, Nov 27, 2026"
keys=("指标库","column_id","回填","设备标签","归因","backfill")
found=[]
for base in bases:
  if not base.exists(): continue
  for p in base.rglob("*.jsonl"):
    try:
      raw=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    except: continue
    if day_marker not in raw and "2026-11-27" not in raw: continue
    hit_keys=[k for k in keys if k in raw]
    if not hit_keys: continue
    # extract user queries with Nov 27
    users=[]
    for line in raw.splitlines():
      try: o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      msg=o.get("message") or {}
      role=msg.get("role") or o.get("role")
      content=msg.get("content")
      text=""
      if isinstance(content,list):
        text="\n".join(c.get("text","") for c in content if isinstance(c,dict) and c.get("type")=="text")
      elif isinstance(content,str): text=content
      if role=="user" and ("Nov 27, 2026" in text or "2026-11-27" in text):
        # strip tags roughly
        m=re.search(r"<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>", text, re.S)
        q=m.group(1).strip() if m else text[:300]
        users.append(q[:250].replace("\n"," "))
    found.append((p, hit_keys, users))
print("files", len(found))
for p, hk, users in found:
  print("---", p)
  print("keys", hk)
  for u in users[:10]:
    print("U:", u[:220])
PY

arguments.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT app_id, TRIM(uid) AS uid,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_page_key), '')) AS page_key
  FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23'
    AND uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(uid) <> ''
), base_f AS (
  SELECT * FROM base
  WHERE page_key IS NOT NULL AND page_key <> '' AND length(page_key) <= 64
    AND NOT (
      TRIM(uid) IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest','test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
      OR TRIM(uid) RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
      OR LOWER(TRIM(uid)) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
      OR TRIM(uid) RLIKE '^__GUEST__'
    )
), new_side AS (
  SELECT app_id, page_key, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS uid_n
  FROM base_f
  GROUP BY app_id, page_key
), old_side AS (
  SELECT app_id, page_key, uid_cnt AS uid_old
  FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23'
), j AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN n.app_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_miss_new,
    CASE WHEN o.app_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_miss_old,
    CASE WHEN n.app_id IS NOT NULL AND o.app_id IS NOT NULL AND n.uid_n <> o.uid_old THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_diff
  FROM new_side n
  FULL OUTER JOIN old_side o
    ON n.app_id = o.app_id AND n.page_key = o.page_key
)
SELECT SUM(is_miss_new) AS miss_new, SUM(is_miss_old) AS miss_old, SUM(is_diff) AS diff_cnt, COUNT(*) AS pair_rows
FROM j

WITH base AS (
  SELECT app_id, TRIM(uid) AS uid,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_page_key), '')) AS pk,
    NULLIF(TRIM(referrer_page_key), '') AS ref_pk
  FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23'
    AND uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(uid) <> ''
), base_f AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE pk IS NOT NULL AND pk <> '' AND length(pk) <= 64
), base_nw AS (
  SELECT * FROM base_f
  WHERE NOT (
    uid IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest','test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
    OR uid RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
    OR LOWER(uid) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
    OR uid RLIKE '^__GUEST__'
  )
), agg_page AS (
  SELECT app_id, pk AS page_key, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS uid_n FROM base_nw GROUP BY app_id, pk
), agg_jump AS (
  SELECT app_id, ref_pk AS page_key
  FROM base_f
  WHERE ref_pk IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(ref_pk)) <> 'unknown'
    AND pk IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(pk)) <> 'unknown'
    AND ref_pk <> pk AND length(ref_pk) <= 64
  GROUP BY app_id, ref_pk
), agg_stay AS (
  SELECT app_id, NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), '') AS page_key
  FROM paimon.dwm.dwm_app_page_stay_d
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23'
    AND uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(uid) <> ''
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND length(NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), '')) <= 64
  GROUP BY app_id, NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), '')
), page_keys AS (
  SELECT app_id, page_key FROM agg_page
  UNION SELECT app_id, page_key FROM agg_jump
  UNION SELECT app_id, page_key FROM agg_stay
), new_side AS (
  SELECT k.app_id, k.page_key, COALESCE(p.uid_n, 0) AS uid_n
  FROM page_keys k
  LEFT JOIN agg_page p ON k.app_id = p.app_id AND k.page_key = p.page_key
), old_side AS (
  SELECT app_id, page_key, uid_cnt AS uid_old
  FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23'
), j AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN n.app_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_miss_new,
    CASE WHEN o.app_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_miss_old,
    CASE WHEN n.app_id IS NOT NULL AND o.app_id IS NOT NULL AND n.uid_n <> o.uid_old THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_diff,
    n.uid_n, o.uid_old
  FROM new_side n
  FULL OUTER JOIN old_side o ON n.app_id = o.app_id AND n.page_key = o.page_key
)
SELECT SUM(is_miss_new) AS miss_new, SUM(is_miss_old) AS miss_old, SUM(is_diff) AS diff_cnt, COUNT(*) AS pair_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_diff=1 THEN abs(uid_n - uid_old) ELSE 0 END) AS abs_uid_gap_sum
FROM j

WITH base AS (
  SELECT app_id, TRIM(uid) AS uid,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_page_key), '')) AS pk
  FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23'
    AND uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(uid) <> ''
), base_f AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE pk IS NOT NULL AND pk <> '' AND length(pk) <= 64
), weird AS (
  SELECT app_id, pk AS page_key, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS weird_n
  FROM base_f
  WHERE (
    uid IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest','test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
    OR uid RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
    OR LOWER(uid) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
    OR uid RLIKE '^__GUEST__'
  )
  GROUP BY app_id, pk
), all_u AS (
  SELECT app_id, pk AS page_key, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS all_n FROM base_f GROUP BY app_id, pk
), nw AS (
  SELECT app_id, pk AS page_key, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS nw_n FROM base_f
  WHERE NOT (
    uid IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest','test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
    OR uid RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
    OR LOWER(uid) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
    OR uid RLIKE '^__GUEST__'
  )
  GROUP BY app_id, pk
), old_side AS (
  SELECT app_id, page_key, uid_cnt AS uid_old
  FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d WHERE dt='2026-11-23'
), diffs AS (
  SELECT o.app_id, o.page_key, o.uid_old, COALESCE(n.nw_n,0) AS uid_n,
    COALESCE(w.weird_n,0) AS weird_n, COALESCE(a.all_n,0) AS all_n
  FROM old_side o
  LEFT JOIN nw n ON o.app_id=n.app_id AND o.page_key=n.page_key
  LEFT JOIN weird w ON o.app_id=w.app_id AND o.page_key=w.page_key
  LEFT JOIN all_u a ON o.app_id=a.app_id AND o.page_key=a.page_key
  WHERE COALESCE(n.nw_n,0) <> o.uid_old
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS diff_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN uid_old - uid_n = weird_n THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS explained_by_weird,
  SUM(CASE WHEN uid_old = all_n AND uid_n = all_n - weird_n THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS old_equals_all_uids,
  SUM(CASE WHEN uid_old - uid_n = 1 AND weird_n >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS off_by_1_with_weird
FROM diffs

WITH base AS (
  SELECT app_id, TRIM(uid) AS uid,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_page_key), '')) AS pk
  FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23' AND uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(uid) <> ''
), base_f AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE pk IS NOT NULL AND pk <> '' AND length(pk) <= 64
), nw AS (
  SELECT app_id, pk AS page_key, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS uid_n FROM base_f
  WHERE NOT (
    uid IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest','test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
    OR uid RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
    OR LOWER(uid) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
    OR uid RLIKE '^__GUEST__'
  ) GROUP BY app_id, pk
), diffs AS (
  SELECT o.app_id, o.page_key, o.uid_cnt AS uid_old, COALESCE(n.uid_n,0) AS uid_n,
    o.uid_cnt - COALESCE(n.uid_n,0) AS gap
  FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d o
  LEFT JOIN nw n ON o.app_id=n.app_id AND o.page_key=n.page_key
  WHERE o.dt='2026-11-23' AND o.uid_cnt <> COALESCE(n.uid_n,0)
)
SELECT gap, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM diffs GROUP BY gap ORDER BY cnt DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT app_id, TRIM(uid) AS uid,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_page_key), '')) AS pk
  FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23' AND uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(uid) <> ''
), base_f AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE pk IS NOT NULL AND pk <> '' AND length(pk) <= 64
), nw AS (
  SELECT app_id, pk AS page_key, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS uid_n FROM base_f
  WHERE NOT (
    uid IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest','test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
    OR uid RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
    OR LOWER(uid) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
    OR uid RLIKE '^__GUEST__'
  ) GROUP BY app_id, pk
), weird AS (
  SELECT app_id, pk AS page_key, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS weird_n, MIN(uid) AS sample_weird FROM base_f
  WHERE (
    uid IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest','test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
    OR uid RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
    OR LOWER(uid) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
    OR uid RLIKE '^__GUEST__'
  ) GROUP BY app_id, pk
), diffs AS (
  SELECT o.app_id, o.page_key, o.uid_cnt AS uid_old, COALESCE(n.uid_n,0) AS uid_n,
    COALESCE(w.weird_n,0) AS weird_n, w.sample_weird
  FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d o
  LEFT JOIN nw n ON o.app_id=n.app_id AND o.page_key=n.page_key
  LEFT JOIN weird w ON o.app_id=w.app_id AND o.page_key=w.page_key
  WHERE o.dt='2026-11-23' AND o.uid_cnt <> COALESCE(n.uid_n,0)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS diff_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN weird_n = uid_old - uid_n THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gap_eq_weird,
  SUM(CASE WHEN weird_n > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_weird,
  SUM(CASE WHEN weird_n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_weird
FROM diffs
